name: Grade 7 IIT Practice: August Week 11 - Improve
description: Practice words for improving game features.

words.definition: A number that tracks points or progress.
words.example: The score display moved to the top corner.

words.definition: A tool or variable that tracks time.
words.example: The timer gave players thirty seconds to finish.

words.definition: Keeping work clear and easy to follow.
words.example: Organization kept the scripts grouped by sprite.

words.definition: How well something does what it should do.
words.example: Functionality improved when every button worked.

words.definition: A real use for a skill or project.
words.example: The application showed how loops and variables can make a game.

words.definition: Thinking about what happened and what you learned.
words.example: The reflection explained which block was hardest to use.
